plugins.name: capacity-planning
plugins.description: The capacity-planning role on contract v3 (issue-160 round-4 promotion). Decides: 향후 수요 성장 대비 자원이 충분하며 언제 증설해야 하는가.

plugins.name: capacity-forecast-method
plugins.description: Forecast-method selection methodology plugin (SRE book Capacity Planning chapter organic/inorganic framing): data-shape classification -> named technique + justification, phase-1 proposal surface only.

plugins.name: capacity-threshold-decomposition
plugins.description: Threshold-decomposition methodology plugin (Little's Law): growth_rate x lead_time x safety_buffer, percentile-stated, never a bare flat percentage. Fires on both phase-1 proposal and phase-2 record surfaces.

plugins.name: capacity-headroom-costnote
plugins.description: Headroom-as-band + cost-attribution methodology plugin (Universal Scalability Law non-linear degradation near capacity): band-not-snapshot headroom, cost attributed to the firing threshold. Phase-2 record surface only.

plugins.name: capacity-order-enforcement
plugins.description: Citation-presence / document-sequencing methodology plugin (survey -> scout-brief -> proposal): precondition every other phase-1 plugin's content check depends on. Phase-1 proposal and phase-1 report surfaces only.
